question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

Our _____ conducted a _____ to get everyone's opinion.
solution:
Here is the solution to the question in the given HTML format:

```html
The correct answer is '**principal; poll**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**principal**" refers to a person who has the highest authority or is the most important person in an organization or group, such as the head of a school. (प्रधानाचार्य)
 
• The word "**poll**" means a survey or a voting process to gather opinions. (मतदान)
 
• The other options: "**principle; poll**," "**principle; pole**," and "**principal; pole**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Our principal__ conducted a __poll__ to get everyone's opinion.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Principle (सिद्धांत)**: means a fundamental truth or proposition that serves as the foundation for a system of belief or behavior.
 
• **Pole (ध्रुव)**: means either of the two locations (North Pole or South Pole) on the surface of the earth.

```
